required_content_goals: 特色/活动/理由与地点对应
形成可执行的游览方案
target_format.fixed_opening: I'm glad you are coming to visit our town. Here is my plan for your day.
target_format.fixed_closing: I hope you will enjoy your visit.

author_positive_body: First, you can visit West Park beside the river. There are many trees and a small lake. We can walk along the water and take photos. After lunch, let's go to the old toy museum opposite the station. It is small, but you can see how children played in the past. You can also try making a wooden toy there. These two places are close, so we can walk between them. Please bring comfortable shoes and some water. I hope you will enjoy your visit.
author_negative_body: Our town is a wonderful place to live. I usually get up at seven and have breakfast with my family. Then I go to school by bus. My favourite subject is English because our teacher is very kind. At weekends, I often play basketball with my friends. There are many shops and restaurants here. People in our town are friendly. The weather is usually nice in summer. You can buy lots of things when you come. I hope you will enjoy your visit.

author_positive_goal_support.evidence: West Park beside the river；toy museum opposite the station，恰两处。
